name: Galápagos National Park
tagline: Galápagos — Santa Cruz visitor slice; giant tortoises never promised.

practical.ticket_note: Parque Nacional Galápagos entry is required; check current fees.
practical.transit_note: Fly to Baltra or San Cristóbal; Santa Cruz is the usual first slice.
practical.energy_note: Sun and heat; stay on marked paths; licensed guide rules apply.
practical.best_start: Santa Cruz visitor center → one highland stop → leave while happy
practical.season_note: Year-round; landings and paths can close. Sightings aren’t promised.
